title: Towards an Environmental Ethics of Artificial Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative philosophical analysis applying environmental justice frameworks (distributive, procedural, and recognition justice) to critique the systemic exclusion of ecological impacts and non-human actors in AI design and ethical evaluations.

Theoretical evaluation examining how institutionalized cultural values and AI design trade-offs (e.g., prioritizing compute-heavy model accuracy over environmental preservation) implicitly devalue non-human animals and ecosystems, conceptualizing this as a form of misrecognition.
